# Configuration

Edit the chunk below before knitting (or sourcing interactively). All other chunks run automatically with no further edits required.

```{r config}
# =============================================================================
# USER CONFIGURATION — edit these values for each new dataset
# =============================================================================

# Plate size: number of wells (e.g. 12 or 24)
PLATE_SIZE <- 12

# Path to the raw plate-data CSV
INPUT_FILE <- "../data/survivalassay_SP2/AP_cockles-26C.csv"

# Path to the replicate metadata CSV
# Expected columns: PlateID, well, Field_Replicate, Silo_Replicate
# Use "blank" (any case) in Field_Replicate / Silo_Replicate to mark blanks.
REPLICATE_META_FILE <- "../data/survivalassay_SP2/APC-T2-replicate_tracking.csv"

# Output file path (set to NULL to auto-generate from INPUT_FILE name)
OUTPUT_FILE <- "../data/survivalassay_SP2/AP_cockles-26C_mortality.csv"

# Assay temperature label, appended to PlateID in output (e.g. "26C", "40C")
TEMPERATURE <- "26C"

# Site code used in the raw plate data (may differ from the metadata file)
# e.g. raw file uses "AP", metadata file uses "APC"
SITE_CODE <- "AP"

# Treatment metadata: treatment code -> c(Immune_Priming, Heat_Priming)
TREATMENT_INFO <- list(
  "CC" = c("No",  "No"),
  "EE" = c("No",  "Yes"),
  "CP" = c("Yes", "No"),
  "EP" = c("Yes", "Yes")
)
```

# Helper Functions

```{r helpers}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# parse_plate_id()
# Parses a plate ID string such as "AP-CC1-26" or "APC-EE3-40" into its
# component parts.  Returns a named list.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parse_plate_id <- function(plate_id) {
  m <- regmatches(
    plate_id,
    regexec("^([^-]+)-([A-Z]+)(\\d+)-(\\d+)$", plate_id)
  )[[1]]
  if (length(m) == 0) stop(paste("Cannot parse plate ID:", plate_id))
  list(
    site           = m[2],
    treatment_code = m[3],
    replicate      = as.integer(m[4]),
    assay_temp     = paste0(m[5], "C")
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# load_replicate_meta()
# Reads the replicate metadata file and returns a lookup list keyed by
# "<PlateID>_<well>" (e.g. "APC-EE4-26_A2").
#
# The metadata PlateID may use a different site code than the raw data
# (e.g. "APC" vs "AP").  meta_site_code is extracted automatically from
# the first non-header row of the metadata file; raw_site_code is the
# SITE_CODE set in config.  When they differ, keys are stored under BOTH
# the metadata site code AND the raw site code so lookups always succeed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
load_replicate_meta <- function(meta_file, raw_site_code) {
  meta <- read.csv(
    meta_file,
    header          = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    strip.white     = TRUE
  )

  required_cols <- c("PlateID", "well", "Field_Replicate", "Silo_Replicate")
  missing <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(meta))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Replicate metadata file is missing columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # Detect site code used in the metadata file
  meta_site_code <- sub("-.*$", "", meta$PlateID[1])

  lookup <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta))) {
    pid  <- meta$PlateID[i]
    well <- meta$well[i]
    fr   <- meta$Field_Replicate[i]
    sr   <- meta$Silo_Replicate[i]

    entry <- list(
      Field_Replicate = fr,
      Silo_Replicate  = sr,
      is_blank        = tolower(fr) == "blank" | tolower(sr) == "blank"
    )

    key_meta <- paste0(pid, "_", well)
    lookup[[key_meta]] <- entry

    # Also store under raw site code if it differs
    if (!is.na(raw_site_code) && meta_site_code != raw_site_code) {
      pid_raw  <- sub(paste0("^", meta_site_code), raw_site_code, pid)
      key_raw  <- paste0(pid_raw, "_", well)
      lookup[[key_raw]] <- entry
    }
  }

  message(sprintf(
    "Loaded %d well entries from metadata (metadata site: %s, raw data site: %s)",
    nrow(meta), meta_site_code, raw_site_code
  ))
  lookup
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# get_plate_dimensions()
# Returns the number of rows and columns for a given plate size.
# Extend this list if you use other formats.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_plate_dimensions <- function(plate_size) {
  dims <- list(
    "6"  = c(rows = 2, cols = 3),
    "12" = c(rows = 3, cols = 4),
    "24" = c(rows = 4, cols = 6),
    "48" = c(rows = 6, cols = 8),
    "96" = c(rows = 8, cols = 12)
  )
  key <- as.character(plate_size)
  if (!key %in% names(dims)) {
    stop(paste("Unsupported plate size:", plate_size,
               "— add it to get_plate_dimensions() if needed."))
  }
  dims[[key]]
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Main Transform

```{r transform}
transform_mortality <- function(
  input_file,
  meta_file,
  output_file   = NULL,
  site_code     = SITE_CODE,
  temperature   = TEMPERATURE,
  plate_size    = PLATE_SIZE,
  treatment_info = TREATMENT_INFO
) {

  # ── 0. Load replicate metadata ──────────────────────────────────────────
  rep_lookup <- load_replicate_meta(meta_file, site_code)

  # ── 1. Read raw plate data as a character matrix ─────────────────────────
  raw <- read.csv(
    input_file,
    header          = FALSE,
    colClasses      = "character",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fill            = TRUE,
    check.names     = FALSE
  )
  mat <- as.matrix(raw)
  mat[is.na(mat)] <- ""
  mat <- trimws(mat)

  nrows <- nrow(mat)
  ncols <- ncol(mat)

  # ── 2. Plate dimensions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  dims     <- get_plate_dimensions(plate_size)
  n_rows   <- dims["rows"]   # number of row letters (A, B, C, …)
  n_cols   <- dims["cols"]   # number of well columns (1, 2, 3, …)
  row_labels <- LETTERS[seq_len(n_rows)]

  # ── 3. Find the first plate-header row ───────────────────────────────────
  # A plate ID looks like "AP-CC1-26" or "APC-EE3-40"
  plate_pattern <- "^[A-Za-z]+-[A-Z]+[0-9]+-[0-9]+$"

  first_plate_row <- NA
  for (i in seq_len(nrows)) {
    if (grepl(plate_pattern, mat[i, 1])) {
      first_plate_row <- i
      break
    }
  }
  if (is.na(first_plate_row)) {
    stop("Could not find any plate ID row in the file.")
  }

  # ── 4. Discover all plate column offsets from that header row ────────────
  header_row <- mat[first_plate_row, ]
  plates <- list()
  for (j in seq_len(ncols)) {
    if (grepl(plate_pattern, header_row[j])) {
      plates <- c(plates, list(list(plate_id = header_row[j], col = j)))
    }
  }
  message(sprintf(
    "Found %d plates: %s",
    length(plates),
    paste(sapply(plates, `[[`, "plate_id"), collapse = ", ")
  ))

  # ── 5. Discover all timepoint blocks ─────────────────────────────────────
  hr_pattern <- "^[0-9]+\\.?[0-9]*HR$"
  timepoint_blocks <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrows)) {
    val <- mat[i, 1]
    if (grepl(hr_pattern, val, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      plate_hdr_row <- i + 1
      if (plate_hdr_row <= nrows) {
        timepoint_blocks <- c(
          timepoint_blocks,
          list(list(hr = val, plate_hdr_row = plate_hdr_row))
        )
      }
    }
  }

  # Keep only first occurrence of each HR label
  seen_hrs      <- character(0)
  unique_blocks <- list()
  for (blk in timepoint_blocks) {
    hr_upper <- toupper(blk$hr)
    if (!hr_upper %in% seen_hrs) {
      seen_hrs      <- c(seen_hrs, hr_upper)
      unique_blocks <- c(unique_blocks, list(blk))
    }
  }
  tp_cols <- sapply(unique_blocks, `[[`, "hr")
  message(sprintf(
    "Found %d timepoints: %s",
    length(tp_cols),
    paste(tp_cols, collapse = ", ")
  ))

  # ── 6. Build output records ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  meta_col_names <- c(
    "PlateID_well", "Silo_Replicate", "Field_Replicate",
    "Assay_Replicate", "Immune_Priming", "Heat_Priming", "Assay_Temp"
  )
  records <- list()

  for (pl in plates) {
    plate_id  <- pl$plate_id
    plate_col <- pl$col

    parsed <- tryCatch(
      parse_plate_id(plate_id),
      error = function(e) { warning(e$message); NULL }
    )
    if (is.null(parsed)) next

    tx_info <- treatment_info[[parsed$treatment_code]]
    if (is.null(tx_info)) {
      warning(paste("Unknown treatment code:", parsed$treatment_code, "— using 'Unknown'"))
      tx_info <- c("Unknown", "Unknown")
    }

    # Discover non-blank well columns from metadata for this plate
    # Well columns in the raw data are offset from the plate ID column:
    # col 1 = well col 1 (may be blank), col 2 = well col 2, …
    # We read up to n_cols columns rightward.
    get_data_cols <- function(plate_col) {
      result <- list()
      for (offset in seq_len(n_cols)) {
        abs_col  <- plate_col + offset
        if (abs_col > ncols) break
        col_num  <- mat[first_plate_row + 1, abs_col]   # numeric column label in data block
        if (col_num == "") next
        result <- c(result, list(list(col_num = col_num, col = abs_col)))
      }
      result
    }

    # In the raw data, timepoint blocks repeat the plate header row; we use
    # that row's column labels (1, 2, 3, …) to build the well key for lookup.
    # We discover the column mapping once from the first timepoint block's
    # header row.
    col_map <- list()  # col_num_label -> matrix column index
    for (blk in unique_blocks[1]) {
      hdr <- mat[blk$plate_hdr_row, ]
      for (offset in seq_len(n_cols)) {
        abs_col  <- plate_col + offset
        if (abs_col > ncols) break
        label <- hdr[abs_col]
        if (label != "") col_map[[label]] <- abs_col
      }
      break
    }

    for (row_idx in seq_along(row_labels)) {
      row_label <- row_labels[row_idx]

      for (col_label in names(col_map)) {
        abs_col <- col_map[[col_label]]
        well_id <- paste0(row_label, col_label)   # e.g. "A1", "B3"

        # Look up replicate metadata
        # Try the plate_id as-is first (same site code), then fall back to
        # the alternate site code version (both were registered in load_replicate_meta)
        lookup_key <- paste0(plate_id, "_", well_id)
        meta_entry <- rep_lookup[[lookup_key]]

        if (is.null(meta_entry)) {
          # Well not found in metadata — skip with a warning
          warning(paste("Well not found in replicate metadata, skipping:", lookup_key))
          next
        }

        if (meta_entry$is_blank) next   # skip blank wells silently

        cup_id <- paste0(plate_id, "_", well_id)

        rec <- list(
          "PlateID_well"    = cup_id,
          "Silo_Replicate"  = meta_entry$Silo_Replicate,
          "Field_Replicate" = meta_entry$Field_Replicate,
          "Assay_Replicate" = plate_id,
          "Immune_Priming"  = tx_info[1],
          "Heat_Priming"    = tx_info[2],
          "Assay_Temp"      = parsed$assay_temp
        )

        # Read mortality values for each timepoint
        for (blk in unique_blocks) {
          data_row <- blk$plate_hdr_row + row_idx  # +1 for plate header, then row_idx rows down
          if (data_row > nrows) {
            rec[[blk$hr]] <- NA
            next
          }
          cell_val <- mat[data_row, abs_col]
          if (cell_val == "" || tolower(cell_val) == "blank") {
            rec[[blk$hr]] <- NA
          } else {
            num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cell_val))
            rec[[blk$hr]] <- if (!is.na(num)) as.integer(num) else cell_val
          }
        }

        records <- c(records, list(rec))
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(records) == 0) {
    stop("No records were extracted. Check your metadata file and plate ID patterns.")
  }

  # ── 7. Assemble data frame ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  out_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(records, as.data.frame, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  )
  out_df <- out_df[, c(meta_col_names, tp_cols), drop = FALSE]

  # Drop rows where ALL timepoint columns are NA
  all_na <- apply(out_df[, tp_cols, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) all(is.na(r)))
  out_df <- out_df[!all_na, , drop = FALSE]

  # ── 8. Write output ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(output_file)) {
    base        <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(input_file))
    output_file <- file.path(dirname(input_file), paste0(base, "_mortality.csv"))
  }

  write.csv(out_df, output_file, row.names = FALSE, quote = TRUE)
  message(sprintf("\nSaved %d rows to: %s", nrow(out_df), output_file))
  invisible(out_df)
}
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Run

```{r run}
result <- transform_mortality(
  input_file     = INPUT_FILE,
  meta_file      = REPLICATE_META_FILE,
  output_file    = OUTPUT_FILE,
  site_code      = SITE_CODE,
  temperature    = TEMPERATURE,
  plate_size     = PLATE_SIZE,
  treatment_info = TREATMENT_INFO
)

cat("\nPreview of output (first 10 rows):\n")
print(head(result, 10))
```

# Summary

```{r summary}
cat(sprintf("Total wells processed: %d\n", nrow(result)))
cat(sprintf("Plates:     %s\n", paste(unique(result$Assay_Replicate), collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Timepoints: %s\n", paste(names(result)[8:ncol(result)], collapse = ", ")))
cat(sprintf("Treatments: %s\n",
            paste(unique(paste0(result$Immune_Priming, "/", result$Heat_Priming)),
                  collapse = ", ")))
```
